test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : NHO :: SMT : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : NHO :: SMT : %

Option 1) # = PJO, % = QKR → PJO : NHO :: SMT : QKR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2b328f457ab967315d7996bb707307329fae49d387634e355a1ff1df7224a2e.png] 

Option 2) # = PJQ, % = QLR → PJQ : NHO :: SMT : QLR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf03d5a4eeee29479ee22dee0485cead143a28e5934955a9a801e6fb5ac37c03.png] 

Option 3) # = PJQ, % = QKS → PJQ : NHO :: SMT : QKS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c146cdf0d416c47ad5b3d65e051c5f811a737090d4b712bb5b29975456e0fd39.png] 

Option 4) # = PJQ, % = QKR → PJQ : NHO :: SMT : QKR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/579d41885719abcacfb6f5b9c397c8616e54470d908c27ad7578037426945fc5.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
